cases.purpose: moves to /var/tmp (a different tmpfs, rename gives EXDEV) and back: a directory tree with nested data, a hardlinked pair and a symlink, a single file and a symlink keep bytes, modes, mtimes and hardlink topology and the sources disappear; an existing non-empty destination directory and an unwritable destination fail; verifies EXDEV and denied destination access before the move
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 mv(1) on the reference side, same guest and per-side mounts
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and the case tree: each invocation is bracketed by "[label]" markers on both streams and followed by its exit status; trusted python3 observers (fsobs.py) print metadata the tree snapshot does not hold. No normalisation. fsobs.py tree prints mode, mtime_ns, nlink and hardlink groups of the moved entries and of what remains in /var/tmp (the tree snapshot covers only the case directory and has no mtimes). r2 of the executed case (filesystem-45): setup now gives every entry the observer prints a fixed mtime, so mtime_ns lines compare preservation instead of the setup clock; steps unchanged.
cases.setup_script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
mkdir -p d/sub e /var/tmp/t/e /var/tmp/ro
printf 'x\0y' >d/sub/f
ln d/sub/f d/h
ln -s sub/f d/l
: >e/y
: >/var/tmp/t/e/x
printf one >f1
ln -s f1 s1
printf z >f2
/usr/bin/touch -h -d @1000000000 d/sub/f d/l d/sub
/usr/bin/touch -d @1000000100 d
/usr/bin/touch -d @1000000200 f1
/usr/bin/touch -h -d @1000000300 s1
chmod 750 d
chmod 640 d/sub/f
chmod 555 /var/tmp/ro
/usr/bin/touch -d @1000000400 e/y /var/tmp/t/e/x f2
/usr/bin/touch -d @1000000500 e /var/tmp/t/e
/usr/bin/touch -d @1000000600 /var/tmp/t /var/tmp/ro
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import errno, os
assert os.geteuid() != 0 and not os.access("/var/tmp/ro", os.W_OK), "CONTROL-FAILED writable destination"
open("exdev-probe", "w").close()
try:
 os.rename("exdev-probe", "/var/tmp/exdev-probe")
except OSError as e:
 assert e.errno == errno.EXDEV, "CONTROL-FAILED rename is not EXDEV"
else:
 raise AssertionError("CONTROL-FAILED rename succeeded")
os.unlink("exdev-probe")'
cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
r() { local label=$1; shift; echo "[$label]"; echo "[$label]" >&2; "$@"; echo "[$label] status=$?"; }
r dir-out mv d /var/tmp/d
/usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py tree /var/tmp/d d
r dir-back mv /var/tmp/d back
r file-out mv f1 /var/tmp/f1
r file-back mv /var/tmp/f1 f1back
r link-out mv s1 /var/tmp/s1
r link-back mv /var/tmp/s1 s1back
r nonempty-dest mv e /var/tmp/t
r unwritable-dest mv f2 /var/tmp/ro/
/usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py tree back f1back s1back e f2 d f1 s1
/usr/bin/python3 fsobs.py tree /var/tmp/t /var/tmp/ro /var/tmp/d /var/tmp/f1 /var/tmp/s1
/usr/bin/chmod 755 /var/tmp/ro

cases.purpose: Verify cross-device failures preserve both operands and compare diagnostics for a non-empty directory and a genuinely unwritable destination.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 mv on the same guest
cases.comparison: Compare status, stderr and preserved bytes. Setup fails if EXDEV or permission denial is absent.
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p tree /var/tmp/mv-t142/target/tree /var/tmp/mv-t142/ro
printf source >tree/data
printf existing >/var/tmp/mv-t142/target/tree/data
printf payload >file
chmod 555 /var/tmp/mv-t142/ro
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import errno, os
assert os.geteuid() != 0 and not os.access("/var/tmp/mv-t142/ro", os.W_OK), "CONTROL-FAILED writable destination"
open("probe", "w").close()
try:
 os.rename("probe", "/var/tmp/mv-t142/probe")
except OSError as e:
 assert e.errno == errno.EXDEV, "CONTROL-FAILED rename is not EXDEV"
else:
 raise AssertionError("CONTROL-FAILED rename succeeded")
os.unlink("probe")'
cases.script:
mv tree /var/tmp/mv-t142/target
s1=$?
mv file /var/tmp/mv-t142/ro/
s2=$?
printf 'statuses %s %s\n' "$s1" "$s2"
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
for p in ("tree/data", "/var/tmp/mv-t142/target/tree/data", "file"):
 print(p, Path(p).read_bytes().hex())
print("destination-created", Path("/var/tmp/mv-t142/ro/file").exists())'
chmod 755 /var/tmp/mv-t142/ro
[ "$s1" -ne 0 ] && [ "$s2" -ne 0 ]
